_publicationNotice: Sanitized historical record, not a new test or operational approval. Identifiers are placeholders; original private evidence is retained separately. Recorded statuses/times/results are historical, not current state. Sanitized bytes cannot verify original hashes.
scope: Local AST-extracted functions and mocked workflows only; not cloud, browser, authentication, or live watchdog validation.
operationalCaution: The already-running watchdog retains its loaded functions. A -Restore invocation while its event exists only signals that watchdog; these tests do not repair or validate the active process.

assertions.assertion: Transient failure is recovered and readback verified.
First-policy failure does not prevent second-policy cleanup.
Only the failed policy is retried.
Successful final ledger retains the prior error history.
p1 removes introduced u1 only; preexisting u2 and unrelated exclusions survive.
p1 preserves concurrent unrelated policy fields.
p2 removes introduced u1 only; preexisting u2 and unrelated exclusions survive.
p2 preserves concurrent unrelated policy fields.
Every PATCH contains only conditions.users.excludeUsers.
Repeated restoration verifies without new PATCHes.
Permanent failure throws a critical error; never claims restoration.
Six bounded first-policy attempts do not block second-policy success.
Retry delays are bounded at 5, 15, 30, 60, and 120 seconds.
Final ledger names the outstanding policy and all six errors.
Readback with a remaining introduced exclusion fails and is retried.
Unowned exclusion is fatal for that policy only.
Preexisting exclusion cannot be removed by a malformed ownership ledger.
Persistence failure is surfaced as a critical ledger error.
Ledger I/O failure does not prevent either policy cleanup.
Authentication failures are bounded independently for both policies.
Both unverified policies and all authentication failures reach the ledger.
Valid baseline permits introduced-only removal.
Missing ownership baseline fails closed without mutation.
Missing first-policy baseline does not abort second-policy cleanup.
